call_points.text: Aims to install at least 1 crore smart meters in FY27 against annual capacity of over 1.8 crore meters.
Order book including SPVs and the GIC Platform was about ₹24,020 Cr as on 30 June 2026, excluding taxes.
About 8–9 crore electricity meters are expected to be tendered in FY27, out of 31–32 crore meters to go smart.
Expects 50-75 days improvement in working-capital days in FY27, with positive operating cash flow from FY28.
O&M revenue expected to reach ₹600–700 Cr from FY28, rising to ₹1,100–1,200 Cr as the installed base matures.
Gas metering opportunity in India estimated at ₹35,000–36,000 Cr over the next 3–4 years.
Sees about ₹500 Cr of international business potential over the next 3–4 years.
All projects have achieved operational go-live, which management expects to progressively ease working-capital intensity.
Management expects FY27 revenue of ₹6,000 crore to ₹6,500 crore.

timeline.summary: Genus Power Infrastructures announced postal ballot results passing resolutions for appointing Nathu Lal Nama as Executive Director and revising borrowing powers.
Shareholders approved all resolutions via postal ballot on May 07, 2026, with Puran Singh Rathore (Joint Company Secretary) confirming compliance.
Genus Power announced postal ballot results approving Nathu Lal Nama's appointment and enhanced borrowing powers.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,537.13 Cr (+64.1% YoY), net profit ₹171.76 Cr (+39.3% YoY).
Genus Power reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,524 Cr (+63% YoY) and FY26 revenue of ₹4,738 Cr with an order book of ₹25,173 Cr.

Puran Singh Rathore, Joint Company Secretary & Compliance Officer, informed BSE and NSE of the uploaded audio recording link for the Investors/Analyst conference call on March 31, 2026, financial results.
Genus Power held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 19, 2026, guiding for FY27 revenue of ₹6,000-6,500 Cr.
Genus Power approved a ₹148.20 Cr share buyback of up to 47.50 lakh shares at ₹312 per share via tender offer, setting October 30, 2026 as record date.
